def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    par_value = 1000
    coupon_rate = 0.10
    spot_1_year = 0.06
    forward_1_year_from_year_1 = 0.08
    forward_1_year_from_year_2 = 0.10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    coupon_payment = par_value * coupon_rate
    discount_factor_1 = 1 / (1 + spot_1_year)
    discount_factor_2 = discount_factor_1 / (1 + forward_1_year_from_year_1)
    discount_factor_3 = discount_factor_2 / (1 + forward_1_year_from_year_2)

    bond_value = (
        coupon_payment * discount_factor_1
        + coupon_payment * discount_factor_2
        + (coupon_payment + par_value) * discount_factor_3
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_value, 3)
